recording.lineage: AKG c460b > CK63 Hyper caps (aimed at the stacks) > Stewart PS-1 > DA-P20 Master DAT at 16/48. Tapers Section. | LINEAGE: Master DAT played back on Tascam DA-20 MKII > Coax Digi > Tascam DR-680 > SD Card. SD Card > Computer Hard Drive. PROCESSING: Reaper (Mix the 2 sources, Volume Envelope to raise the levels on the first set to match the second, ReEQ EQ, ReaComp with NY Comp preset and 50% Wet/Dry, LoudMax limiting, render to Flac 16/48) > Foobar2000 (tagging). DAT tape transferred 3/2020, edited and uploaded 7/2/2025.
